result.title: This AI Turns Insane Ideas Into 3D Objects
result.description:
This was just a picture… and now it’s a 3D-printable object. 

A new AI model called Tripo 2.0 can take almost any image and turn it into a full 3D model you can export to Blender, Unreal Engine, or a 3D printer.

The possibilities are wild: custom game characters, collectibles, animation assets, product prototypes, or literally anything you can imagine.

What would you create with it?

result.title: This Robot Can Learn Almost ANY Task
result.description:
This robot can repot plants, make pour-over coffee, assemble kits, and even cook pancakes. 

And all of those tasks were learned from a single video demonstration.

Skild AI’s new S1 model can recreate tasks lasting up to 10 minutes, with dozens of individual step, WITHOUT any fine-tuning or additional training.

It’s basically prompting...but for robots.
